messages:
alex: anyone else seeing GPU exporter remote_write 504 spikes in us-west-2? started ~11:58 UTC, correlates with node autoscale churn.

maria: yep noticed p95 write latency jumped and a bunch of `write 504` from proxy. metrics look like queue growth on proxy pods :eyes:

jin: stack: prometheus -> sidecar -> remotewrite-proxy -> cortex. sidecar logs show connection resets. pushing through proxy seems to hit conn limit then 504.

maria: log snippets:
```
W 11:58:34 sidecar.go:212: write to proxy failed: Post "https://rw-prod-usw2.example.com/api/write": dial tcp 10.20.30.40:443: connect: connection refused
E 11:58:35 remote_write.go:99: remote_write failed, status=504, body="upstream request timeout"
```

alex: proxy autoscale didn't spin up fast enough when GPU node group scaled. I see bursts of new pods registering then leaving. suspect conn tracking / firewall NAT port exhaustion on node NATGW.

observability-bot: Alert fired: prometheus.remotewrite.http_errors > 50 (5m) — triggered 11:59 UTC

jin: quick diff in proxy config shows `max_conns_per_upstream` was lowered in the last deploy. rolling back to previous value reduced errors in staging. can we try that on prod canary?

maria: also saw relabel rule `exporter_instance -> pod_ip` expanded cardinality after new sidecar image added `instance_id` label. that may increase remote_write payload size.

alex: good catch. relabel snippet:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_instance_id]
  target_label: instance_id
```
we should drop instance_id for exporters. adds low-value high-card label.

jin: can we patch proxy to increase connection_keepalive and bump upstream concurrency? patch looks safe for canary.

sre-oncall: proceeding with small canary 5% traffic to new proxy config and relabel drop. will monitor p95 and error rate for 10m. tagging @maria @alex

maria: also recommend adding NAT metrics dashboard (conn count, ephemeral ports used) for the nodepool. surprised NATGW close_waits spiked.

ops-bot: Deploy started: proxy-config-v2 -> canary(5%) by jin at 12:04 UTC

alex: after canary, p95 dropped from 220ms to 90ms and 504s decreased. still seeing occasional bursts, possibly due to kube-proxy conn tracking during pod churn. adding `conntrack` tuning to node pool config as next step.

jin: filed infra ticket: INFRA-8342 adjust nodepool conntrack settings and add NATGW autoscale margin. linking k8s kernel params + quick remediation steps.

maria: followup: revert relabel rule in prometheus job to remove instance_id and enable prefix K/V cache on sidecar to reduce payload duplication.

sre-oncall: closing thread for now, monitoring for 1h. reopen if error rate > 10/min. :thumbsup:
